fog.description: Very light atmospheric mist with high visibility
fog.material_emphasis: foreground and midground remain clear and detailed, background only slightly softened
fog.atmosphere: subtle haze, mostly clear air, normal contrast, only a gentle sense of distance
fog.additional_instruction: Use only a thin, delicate mist that keeps the scene mostly clear. Preserve sharp edges, material detail, and color saturation. Avoid thick or cinematic fog, avoid strong haze, bloom, glow, or god rays. Do NOT obscure buildings or landscape; visibility should extend far into the distance.

crystal_clear.material_emphasis: crisp glass, sharp reflections, high clarity
crystal_clear.additional_instruction: Eliminate haze; emphasize clarity, reflections, and fine detail.

bloom.additional_instruction: Add bloom around lights and highlights while keeping overall exposure balanced.
